baseline.source: Independent current-public and exact built-preview review at 320, 390 and 1440px after batch12 public acceptance. All five quick chips exist in the DOM and filters work, but at 320/390 only Couples, Family and Group read clearly; the next faded chip appears behind the pinned Filters action. baseline.priorIndependentReviews: Stay iteration11 recorded 81/90, 74.75/90 and 79/95 assessed points with full scores null. No full independent post-batch12 regrade exists.

hypothesis: Exposing all five Stay intent chips on small screens and naming the advanced action All filters improves discoverability without changing filter state or results.
boundedChange: Add optional mobileWrap and moreLabel props to the shared FilterBar; use both only on the Stay hub. Keep Eat and other filter surfaces on their existing defaults. No filter taxonomy, ranking, result or sort logic changes.
metric: At 320 and 390px all five quick chips and All filters are visible without clipping/overlap or horizontal overflow; Dog-friendly changes the result count and opens the advanced sheet; keyboard focus and close/recovery work; desktop and Eat retain usable controls. Exact local build, CI and public browser verify the release.
rollback: Remove the Stay-specific mobileWrap and moreLabel props if the wrapped controls cause layout or interaction regressions.
independentReview: Independent final preview review gave a bounded GO: all five 48px Stay chips remained visible at 320/390px; Dog-friendly changed 26 to 4 results by touch and keyboard; the advanced dialog opened with focus, Escape closed it and restored focus. No overflow or page errors. The reviewer did not assign a full 23-criterion score.

validation.productionBuild: Final exact-source TZ=UTC npm run build:search passed, including content and provenance checks, 1009 generated pages and a Pagefind index of 727 pages.

Independent final responsive and keyboard QA gave a bounded GO. Eat at 390px retained its default filter design and working Filters action.
